profile.headline: Platforms, Teams, Engineering.
profile.summary:
Passionate for building great products and teams. 

Most of my professional experience has been with startups, building products and solving lot of problems. Sometimes not even related to software engineering. I consider myself a generalist, Highly proficient with programming in JVM ecosystem and at the same time never hesitant to jump into any language or stack. 

I write solid back-end code, can work with multitude of data stores, automate ops and also deal with front-end with relative ease. Able to work as an independent contributor but working in collaborative and diverse environment is something I truly love.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I contributed to the success of Citrine Informatics by delivering impactful prototypes that informed our product strategy.  

• Developed solutions that resulted in measurable improvements to platform performance and user experience.  
• Enhanced cross-functional communication, leading to a more collaborative and efficient development process.  
• Strengthened analytical skills by tackling complex technical challenges, ensuring seamless integration of new features.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Part of Smaato's core engineering team that builds and maintains the core platform that serves 35bn requests a day with sub-second latencies.

Responsibilities include, but not limited to;
Adding new features to product without affecting performance and follow standard best practices
Participate in design and decision making processes.
Bringing in better tooling and practices for the team for day to day work.

Highlight:
Worked on bringing in container technology (docker) to improve existing automation testing and cut down commit to test cycle.

Worked on bringing in release automation and CD for the team that helps cut down time invested into rolling out and maintaining large infrastructure spanning 4 different regions and >500 nodes combined while ensuring no downtimes affect critical business.

positions.title: Senior Software Analyst
positions.description:
• Spearheaded software engineering initiatives, enhancing development processes and integrating DevOps practices.  
• Mentored team members, instilling best practices that improved code quality and delivery efficiency.  
• Contributed to customer value delivery by optimizing the engineering ecosystem, resulting in a 20% reduction in project turnaround time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I spearheaded the development of a high-throughput reconciliation product, significantly improving user experience and operational efficiency.  

• Drove product engineering initiatives, translating user feedback into actionable features.  
• Fostered collaboration with the solution engineering team, ensuring effective technology solutions and deployments.  
• Enhanced my skills in product design, user-centric development, and cross-team collaboration.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
Founding Engineer on development of Ecolibrium's flagship clean-tech product, significantly impacting the company's growth trajectory.  

• Engaged in critical early-stage engineering and business decisions, enhancing product-market fit.  
• Fostered a collaborative environment that encouraged innovative thinking and problem-solving.  
• Enhanced my skills in project management, product development, and strategic planning within the clean-tech sector.
